overall_summary: Most videos suffer from very low view counts, indicating early-stage channel distribution struggles. However, content focused on 'self respect' with micro-behavioral hooks like deleting chats, removing pins, or changing ringtones performed marginally better than abstract emotional pieces.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जब रिप्लाई का इंतज़ार खत्म हो जाए' (35 views) and 'चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत' (40 views) outperform abstract topics.
winning_patterns.action: Continue focusing on hyper-specific digital interface moments (chats, lists, settings) rather than general sadness.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'रात के ख्याल और अधूरा इंतजार' (5 views) and 'नंबर ब्लॉक नहीं किया कभी' (6 views) got almost zero traction.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid purely poetic or slow atmospheric openings without an immediate, relatable daily action.

next_video.concept: Removing someone from the phone's auto-suggested contact list when typing a new message.
next_video.opening_direction: कीबोर्ड पर पहला अक्षर टाइप करते ही, स्क्रीन पर उसका नाम सबसे ऊपर आ गया।
next_video.twist_direction: आज उसे रिकमेंडेशन से हटाने के लिए सेटिंग्स में जाना पड़ा, और इस बार दिल की धड़कन बिल्कुल नहीं बढ़ी।
next_video.reason: Tests a fresh micro-behavioral trigger (keyboard auto-suggestions) within the winning 'self respect' topic without repeating the exact 'pinned chat' or 'blocked list' tropes.

experiment: Testing keyboard auto-suggestion deletion as a fresh hook for self-respect to break the repetitive chat-pin/last-seen pattern.
